H: On the original #3807 seeds/data, replacing only rank-4 online minibatch RNG stream seed+35 with shared schedule seed+31 rescues held-out B accuracy; the stream is a candidate explanation, not an asserted cause.

T.data: Exact #3807 frozen CUDA runner data generation, labels and task.
T.base: 8 features, hidden-16 tanh, 4 classes; 512 rows; 400 CUDA AdamW steps, LR .025.
T.model: Rank-4 online LoRA; identical full initial state per seed; AdamW LR .04; seed+24 init; 16 one-at-a-time B rows in seed+30 order; 8 updates/arrival; batch size 32; 128 total steps.
T.mapping: Sampler emits original support row IDs; index x_support and y_support directly by those IDs. Assert every sampled ID belongs to the revealed set. Never use an original row ID as an offset into compact seen[] storage.
T.schedule: Balanced order L>S, S>L, L>S, S>L, L>S; per-arm generator reset to seed+35 or seed+31.
T.retention: All 4096 heldout row predictions for both arms after arrivals 1..16, final metrics, timings, data and sampler hashes, routes, base integrity, initial equality, full-state snapshot/rollback.

D.pass: PASS_SAMPLER_SEED_EXPLAINS_COLLAPSE_SCOPED only if legacy mean <=.10, shared arm >=.90 every seed, paired mean gain >=.50, p95 <=60ms, and every row-level/route/state/base/provenance/audit check passes.
D.hold: HOLD_LEGACY_COLLAPSE_NOT_REPRODUCED if legacy mean >.10; no causal attribution.
D.fail: FAIL_SAMPLER_SEED_NOT_SUFFICIENT if legacy collapse repeats but rescue gate fails; FAIL_ROUTE_OR_STATE_INTEGRITY on violations; typed STOP/HOLD on ambiguity.

C.execution: local host CUDA; no container claim; Docker read-only only

U: Five original synthetic seeds in one binary-factor family. Parent STOP had no online updates or held-out evaluation; reused seed design is not treated as independent replication. No real task, transfer, production safety/latency, or runtime-authority claim.
